nodes.name: MusicVideoCatalogCache.cs
nodes.summary: In-memory thread-safe cache for music video availability, mapping track URIs to video/audio URIs and PlayReady manifest IDs.

nodes.name: MusicVideoDiscoveryService.cs
nodes.summary: Background discovery service that probes track URIs for associated music videos and populates the video catalog cache via NPV mapping and manifest resolution.

nodes.name: MusicVideoMetadataService.cs
nodes.summary: Orchestrates music video metadata resolution — checking availability, resolving video and audio URIs via extended metadata, and handling local video file discovery.

nodes.name: NavigationGcCoordinator.cs
nodes.summary: Coordinates GC pressure during navigation transitions by tracking critical windows and deferring image surface releases until after the animation completes.

nodes.name: NowPlayingHighlightService.cs
nodes.summary: Tracks the currently playing track URI and notifies subscribers so track rows can highlight themselves when their track is playing.

nodes.name: NowPlayingPresentationService.cs
nodes.summary: Manages the now-playing view presentation mode (normal, theatre, fullscreen) and exposes toggle and transition methods.

nodes.name: PageCache.cs
nodes.summary: Generic async page cache with background refresh, suspend/resume control, and invalidation support used by paginated UI views.

nodes.name: PageHostCacheCleanupAdapter.cs
nodes.summary: Adapts the page-host cache lifecycle to the cleanup scheduler, dropping stale entries for collapsed/destroyed page hosts on the UI thread.

nodes.name: PaletteGradientCompositor.cs
nodes.summary: Computes a gradient brush from a track palette (dominant colors) with system-theme-aware fallback for now-playing hero backgrounds.

nodes.name: PathfinderSpotifyTrackSearcher.cs
nodes.summary: Implements track search against the Spotify Pathfinder GraphQL API, returning structured track results for preview and link-resolution flows.

nodes.name: PhiSilicaStructuredTextGenerator.cs
nodes.summary: Wraps the on-device Phi Silica model to generate structured (JSON) or plain text responses, with content-filter mapping and detailed diagnostic logging.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Microsoft.Windows.AI.Text.LanguageModel (Phi Silica) for on-device inference; content filter options capped at Medium severity.

nodes.name: PhiSilicaStructuredTextPipeline.cs
nodes.summary: Orchestrates multi-step Phi Silica inference with retry, fallback, policy sanity probes, token-length clamping, and diagnostic dump on failure.

nodes.name: PiiRedactor.cs
nodes.summary: Scrubs PII patterns (email, bearer tokens, Windows/Unix home paths) from log strings before they are written to crash logs or debug output.

nodes.name: PlaylistMosaicService.cs
nodes.summary: Generates and disk-caches a 2x2 mosaic thumbnail for playlists by compositing cover art tiles from track images using Win2D canvas operations.

nodes.name: PlaylistPrefetcher.cs
nodes.summary: Prefetches playlist metadata and warms the image cache for a batch of playlists, with priority queuing and partial-metadata construction from list v2 responses.

nodes.name: PlaylistPrefetchService.cs
nodes.summary: Coordinates startup playlist prefetch across all library playlists, using PlaylistMetadataPrefetcher to batch-load metadata and warm caches.

nodes.name: PreviewAudioGraphService.cs
nodes.summary: Plays short audio preview clips via WinRT AudioGraph (primary) or MediaPlayer (fallback), with per-quantum FFT frame dispatch for visualizer consumers.

nodes.name: ProfileCache.cs
nodes.summary: Caches Spotify user profile data with diffing of followed artists and playlists to detect and surface incremental library changes.

nodes.name: ProfileFetcher.cs
nodes.summary: Fetches and normalizes Spotify user profile metadata; ProfileService wraps it with an authenticated-user convenience loader.

nodes.name: RecentlyPlayedService.cs
nodes.summary: Maintains the recently-played shelf by merging Home-page recents with live playback context events, resolving artist/album/playlist metadata on demand.

nodes.name: RemoteStateRecorder.cs
nodes.summary: Records dealer messages and HTTP calls (capped at 500 entries) for the Debug page, trimming oversized JSON payloads to keep memory bounded.

nodes.name: SettingsService.cs
nodes.summary: Loads, persists, and debounced-saves app settings as JSON, with early-read peek helpers that bypass DI for log-level and cache-profile bootstrapping.

nodes.name: SharedCardCanvasPreviewService.cs
nodes.summary: Manages a single shared MediaPlayerElement for card hover video previews, serializing acquire/release across callers on the UI thread.

nodes.name: ShellSessionService.cs
nodes.summary: Persists and restores shell layout state (open tabs, sidebar selection, group expansions) across app sessions using a JSON-backed store.

nodes.name: SpotifyLinkPreviewService.cs
nodes.summary: Resolves Spotify entity URIs to preview cards (album, artist, track, show, episode, playlist, user) using Pathfinder GraphQL queries.
